verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS agent-workflow platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production workspace. Nearby features such as the approval gate, advisory PR checks, write-only widget keys and agents working in local checkouts are adjacent controls, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
